zh.title: 中國國航C919執飛北京至烏蘭巴托航線 完成首個定期國際客運航班
zh.summary: 中國國航C919型客機於8月12日完成首個國際商業航班，由北京飛抵烏蘭巴托。
body: 中國國航一架COMAC C919客機於2026年8月12日完成該機型首個定期國際商業航班。該航班（CA723）由編號B-919Y的C919-100(ER)客機執飛，自北京首都國際機場（PEK）起飛，並於當地時間約17時降落於蒙古烏蘭巴托（UBN）。
依據規劃，中國國航將以C919客機於北京至烏蘭巴托航線上執行每日往返航班，航班號碼分別為CA723與CA724。目前中國國航旗下擁有12架C919客機，中國東方航空與中國南方航空亦營運此一機型。
此外，中國商飛與西藏航空聯合開發的C919高高原原型機，已於2026年7月29日在上海浦東國際機場（PVG）完成首飛，該衍生機型規劃載客量為140至160座。

en.title: Air China COMAC C919 Completes First Scheduled International Flight to Mongolia
en.summary: Air China launched the COMAC C919's first international commercial flight from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar on August 12.
body: On August 12, 2026, Air China completed the first scheduled international commercial flight of the COMAC C919 passenger aircraft. Flight CA723, operated by a C919-100(ER) registered B-919Y, departed Beijing Capital International Airport (PEK) and arrived at Ulaanbaatar (UBN) around 17:00 local time.

Air China plans to operate the C919 aircraft on the Beijing-Ulaanbaatar route seven days a week as flights CA723 and CA724. The airline currently has 12 C919 aircraft in its active fleet, alongside existing operations by China Eastern Airlines and China Southern Airlines.

Separately, COMAC's C919 high-altitude prototype completed its maiden test flight on July 29, 2026, in Shanghai. The high-altitude variant is being jointly developed with Tibet Airlines, featuring a seating capacity between 140 and 160 passengers.

zh.title: 西班牙伊比利航空A321XLR於萬呎高空直播日全食
zh.summary: 伊比利航空安排A321XLR客機於高空透過Starlink網路直播日全食。
body: 西班牙伊比利航空（Iberia）安排空中巴士（Airbus）A321XLR 客機執行一項特別飛行任務，預計於 33,000 呎高空飛行，並實況直播當天出現的日全食景觀。
根據航空新聞 Simple Flying 報導，伊比利航空針對該架 A321XLR 客機規劃了特別航線，選定於西班牙帕倫西亞（Palencia）上空進行飛行觀測。
為了在萬呎高空傳輸即時畫面，該架 A321XLR 客機配備高速 Starlink 衛星網路技術，向全球實況播送高空視角的日全食過程。

en.title: Iberia Uses Airbus A321XLR To Livestream Total Solar Eclipse Over Palencia
en.summary: Iberia operates an Airbus A321XLR at 33,000 feet to livestream the total solar eclipse using Starlink.
body: Spanish flag carrier Iberia is operating a specially routed Airbus A321XLR aircraft at an altitude of 33,000 feet to provide a livestream of today's total solar eclipse.
According to coverage by Simple Flying, the airline has configured the A321XLR flight path specifically over Palencia to capture and broadcast the total eclipse event from high altitude.
To transmit the video stream live from 33,000 feet during the flight operation, the Airbus A321XLR is equipped with ultra-fast Starlink satellite internet connectivity.
The unique flight operation allows viewers to follow the solar eclipse in real time through Iberia's broadcast stream, powered by Starlink technology over Palencia.
